channel.title: Live: European Athletics Championships
channel.desc: The women's heptathlon continues on the penultimate day of the European Athletics Championships with the long jump and javelin. Meanwhile, the fastest woman in Europe this season over 1,500m, Georgia Hunter Bell, is in action in qualifying for Sunday's final alongside 2022 champion Laura Muir. We'll also see the sprint relay teams take to the track for the first time in the heats. Jeanette Kwakye is joined in the studio by Jessica Ennis-Hill and Greg Rutherford.
